Sign catalogue

Sign

M194

Looks like: trapezoid with no bottom line, two short outward perpendiculars off bottom left and right and from top center, bird-foot in bottom

From the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 288). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W585 · Medial

Appears in 43 texts (58 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually sits inside a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W585 is in 44 texts, including at Dholavira.

Where it appears 43

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 56 objects in all carry it.
